Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the actual existing game screenshot and edit target. Produce a polished HIGH-FIDELITY redesign mockup for this exact Chinese Cthulhu card game, preserving its established warm oxidized brass, dark teal stone and carved book/tentacle relief art. Preserve landscape 1440:900 composition and crisp legible UI typography.
The narrow full-width rectangular phase/message panel immediately above the hand area looks wrong now that the hand area has a curved silhouette. Remove that entire old rectangle, including its long border. Remove the old loose red hand count label next to the confirm button. Rehouse exactly those two information elements in the new design described below.
Keep the upper player panels, HP/SAN bars, deck piles and adventure log composition exactly as shown. Keep all FIVE existing face-up hand cards and their EXISTING artworks, portrait proportions exactly 392:590, scale, 20% overlap and fan curvature; do not narrow or stretch any card. Keep the sculpted left candle/book/tentacle and right book/tentacle style, brass curved table edge, and established confirm-button material. Keep the cards large. No new enemy zones, support zones, mana, health systems, extra actions or card costs. Do not add a card hover enlargement.
All three designs use the same actual game state: 5 cards held, limit 4, one card needs discarding, none yet selected. Exact readable new Chinese text: "请弃置 1 张手牌" and secondary "已选 0 / 1". Counter must identify itself as "手牌" plus larger "5 / 4". Existing button text "确认弃牌" (inactive until a card is chosen). Use muted amber/ivory for instruction, restrained rust red only for excess count, avoid tiny near-black copy. The information form must have credible space for up to two lines of longer instructions and optional countdown badges in other game states. Keep all copy horizontal, not curved/warped around a ring.
Do not add explanatory arrows, annotations, watermark, comparison-board labels, duplicate UI or fake browser chrome. Output a single complete game-screen proposal, not a mood board. Keep finish grounded and implementable as layered bitmap assets with live text.
LATEST USER CORRECTION, overriding any previous decorative placement:
The upper board and lower hand area should NOT have a hard horizontal division. Remove both the old phase bar and the conspicuous long straight line across the bottom of the central board row. Dissolve the bottom edges/backgrounds of the self-info panel and log softly into the SAME continuous ground background. Keep their content readable and upper player row intact, but use subtle local top/side corners and feathered lower edges instead of connecting bottom borders into a horizontal partition. No new horizontal separator, rectangular platform or contrasting full-width band. The scene should flow naturally from deck area to curved card table.
The HAND COUNT MUST BE UNIVERSAL UI, independent of left/right decorative reliefs. Do NOT attach it to a book, candle, tentacle or theme-specific prop. Keep the existing reliefs just as art in this mockup; later themes can freely replace them without moving or redefining the count.
REVISED A — COUNT IN THE ACTION CLUSTER:
At the left of the hand action row, make a small independent 76x46 px softly faceted bronze-and-dark-teal UI medallion, with a restrained overlapping-cards icon, small straight text "手牌", and large "5 / 4". Place approximately x=315–392,y=535–581. Only the 5 is muted rust red because 5 exceeds the limit 4; slash and 4 remain warm ivory. Immediately to its right at x=405–555,y=536–580 retain the existing "确认弃牌" button with its established subdued carved frame. The medallion is a reusable UI component, not a floating loose text label, and does not touch the scenery.
Place the primary phase instruction "请弃置 1 张手牌" and smaller "已选 0 / 1" above the CENTRAL hand fan, x=630–1060,y=518–564. No rectangular background panel: just crisp horizontal ivory/amber text with a soft dark local halo and two tiny low-contrast brass end glyphs. Avoid a long underline or swoosh that creates another divider. Long messages may use a wider second line. Keep clearance above the card hover range.
Keep all five cards EXACTLY the original 392:590 portrait shapes and fan spacing, existing prop scale/positions, card artworks and area proportions. No larger lower table lip. Keep the UI discreet, refined, continuous, readable.

b2_correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the revised B layout for an actual Chinese Cthulhu card game. Make ONE precise correction only: the curved bronze top edge of the hand table is incorrectly ABOVE the tops of all cards. Lower this curved rail so the upper edges of all five cards protrude about 10–14 pixels ABOVE the brass rail, consistent with the fan curvature. The top center of the rail must pass BEHIND the uppermost cards, not float over them. Remove the currently exposed extra bright arc across the center. Only the side portions of the corrected rail should remain fully visible where they emerge beside the fan. The counter medallion at the LEFT stays an independent UI piece mounted to that rail, with its saddle following the corrected rail height; keep it visually separate from the replaceable book prop. Do not shift, redraw, scale, stretch, narrow, rearrange or otherwise change any of the five card faces, card frame proportions, card text, or their 20% overlap. Preserve all other screen content, text, count, buttons, instruction placement, reliefs, continuous background and softened upper/lower transition unchanged. No new horizontal dividing line. Same canvas and screen framing.
